(A3) setup.py:614,622 `min_cc=90 if _with_cutlass else 0` — DECISION REQUIRED: hardcode min_cc=90 to keep today's Hopper-only fat binary byte-stable (RECOMMENDED), NOT min_cc=0 which broadens the default gencode below Hopper (VERIFIED _supported_gencode's no-accept fallback is ['90'], but with a pre-Hopper nvcc min_cc=0 would accept older CCs and widen the shipped arch set + build time). Coordinate with fix order 3: drop -DWITH_CUTLASS from ci.yml compile_to_object + scripts/{compile_to_object.sh,nvcc_baseline.py} in this same pass.
fixes.risk: MEDIUM (one explicit decision + breadth). PART A is byte-identical to the shipped _ops device code — mma.cuh contributes zero bytes today (zero includes, zero callers, sole WITH_CUTLASS consumer). The ONE non-cosmetic caveat: setup.py:614/622 min_cc — naive removal makes both min_cc=0 and silently broadens the fat binary below Hopper; MUST be an explicit owner decision (recommend hardcode 90). Because compile_to_object passes -DWITH_CUTLASS, retiring WITH_CUTLASS forces a coordinated edit there — do mma.cuh removal AFTER or WITH the compile_to_object glob fix, never leaving compile_to_object globbing mega_*.cu while -DWITH_CUTLASS is dead.

plan.ci_readiness:
GREEN CI = every job in the ci_success required gate (ci.yml:1560-1586) succeeds. Today, on a HEALTHY tree, FOUR required jobs false-fail because the #10-aftermath deleted the 11 sm_90 launch_*.cu + 33 sm_90 mega_<model>_<opt>.cu files while the harnesses still enumerate them: (a) verify_all (runs phases 1,4,5) — Phase 1 'sm_90 launchers (11)' + 'fused cells on disk (99)' FAIL, Phase 4d 'codegen idempotency (99)' FAILs on the 33 missing sm_90 cells; (b) compile_to_object — glob resolves to 6 mega_*.cu, n<44 hard-guard fires '::error::glob broken'; (c) cpp_structural — `cu!=11` (cu=0); (d) docs_consistency — `cu!=11` AND the README assertion (VERIFIED both '11 launch' and '11 files per backend' are absent from README.md, so this arm fails independently) plus stale '99 cells / 33 sm_90 nvcc -c' README claims. The stated scope covers only verify_all + compile_to_object; cpp_structural + docs_consistency are sibling required-gate jobs that false-fail on the IDENTICAL assumption — fix order 4 addresses them as a flagged owner decision. WITHOUT fix 4, fixes 1-3 turn verify_all + compile_to_object green but ci_success stays RED.

APPLY/VERIFY ORDER: 1) verify_all.py re-anchor (order 1) + new Phase-5 production check (order 2) — verify CPU-only: `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m grokking_optimizers.verify_all --phase 1` / `--phase 4` / `--phase 5` all green; gfx942+tpu_v6e still enumerate 66 cells; new Phase-5 asserts _FUSED_L3_REAL/_L3_WGMMA_CELLS len 33, gemm_impl_for_cell=='wgmma', has_l3_real True, launcher opt_id switch covers every OptId. 2) compile_to_object glob+guard (order 3) — verify the glob resolves to exactly the 7 production TUs and the n>=7 guard passes (the nvcc -c step itself needs a CUDA toolkit runner, not a GPU; -c -o /dev/null does not link so no PyInit__ops collision). 3) cpp_structural + docs_consistency + README (order 4) — verify cpp_structural's cu-assertion is replaced with the SM90_REAL_TUS existence check (hip ==11 + removed-symbol scan + bindings-dir checks preserved), and docs_consistency's cu-glob + README-string assertion + README numeric claims are mutually consistent with the 3-REAL-TU / 33-logical-opt_id-cell reality. After 1-3 (orders 1-4 of fixes) land in ONE PR, re-run the full required gate; ci_success should be GREEN. 4) The mma.cuh removal (order 5) is the big dead-weight win, gated on the explicit setup.py min_cc=90-vs-0 owner decision (recommend hardcode 90 to keep the fat binary byte-stable) and MUST drop -DWITH_CUTLASS from compile_to_object + scripts in the same PR; verify `git grep WITH_CUTLASS csrc/` is empty and a CPU `pip install -e . --no-build-isolation` dry-config still selects sm_90a. 5) The three profiler repoints (orders 6-8) are CI-independent (none are in the required gate); their EDITS are CPU-verifiable (import resolves, repointed paths exist, nvcc -c of the real TU) but actual counter CAPTURE needs an H100/MI300X — schedule the GPU validation separately, it does not block CI green.

EXCLUDED-AS-NOT-SAFE: none of the scoped items came back NOT-safe-to-change; all three are confirmed cleanups. See notes for the items deliberately NOT touched within otherwise-safe fixes.
plan.notes:
PARTITION OF SAFETY: All three scoped items are SAFE to change (none excluded wholesale). But each carries surgically-excluded sub-items that must NOT be touched, plus two genuine owner decisions:

DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED (would CREATE new false-fails or break the build):
1. megakernel_codegen.dispatch_table_sm90 / emit_cell + the committed .inc files (fused_dispatch_table.inc etc.) — Phase 5a passes TODAY on mutual self-consistency between the generators and the committed .inc; rewriting the sm_90 generator WITHOUT regenerating the committed .inc would create a brand-new false-fail. The verify_all re-anchor (fix 1) only stops ENUMERATING deleted files; it does not regenerate or recompare sm_90 codegen. This is why Phase 4d guards sm_90 with `continue` rather than fixing emit_cell.
2. profile.py must NOT be deleted — VERIFIED 10 imports in compile.py:171-182 + 8 in utilization.py:48-57 + verify_all + tuning/roofline.py; deletion breaks the BUILD (compile.py). Same for keeping OPT_CLASS importable for back-compat even though the GPU smoke stops using it.
3. scripts/install_deps.sh:52 nvidia-cutlass==3.6.0 PYTHON pin — a DIFFERENT artifact from the third_party/cutlass C++ submodule; it feeds compile.py's `import cutlass` (polyhedral/autotuner codegen). Removing it as part of the mma.cuh/C++-CUTLASS cleanup would break the codegen path. Explicitly carved out.
4. profile_maximal Tiers C/D/E + utilization.py samplers/aggregation + the Pallas/TPU branches in all three profilers — VERIFIED live and correct; untouched.
5. cpp_structural removed-symbol scan, hip gfx942 ==11 assertion, and the bindings-dir ==[bindings.cpp,dispatch.cpp,helpers.h] assertion — all still valid; only the cuda sm_90 ==11 assertion is re-anchored.

TWO GENUINE OWNER DECISIONS (do not auto-resolve):
A. setup.py:614/622 min_cc — after retiring _with_cutlass, `min_cc=90 if _with_cutlass else 0` collapses; hardcoding 0 SILENTLY BROADENS the default fat binary below Hopper (VERIFIED _supported_gencode's only no-accept fallback is ['90'], so on a pre-Hopper nvcc min_cc=0 widens the shipped arch set + build time). Recommend hardcode min_cc=90 to keep the arch surface byte-stable. This is the sole non-cosmetic caveat of the otherwise byte-identical mma.cuh removal.
B. SCOPE BOUNDARY: cpp_structural + docs_consistency (fix 4) are OUT of the stated scope (verify_all + the twin compile_to_object) but are in the SAME required gate and false-fail on the IDENTICAL removed-launch_*.cu / '11-per-arch' assumption. Fixing only the two scoped items leaves ci_success RED. Owner must decide: re-anchor all four jobs (+ README) in one PR (recommended — only path to green), or track the two siblings separately and accept a RED gate.

RESOLVED OPEN QUESTIONS from the scoping pass: (1) SG2 TU filenames — there is NO mega_*_sg2_tc.cu on disk; the sm_90 SG2 surface is only opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh + sg2_meta_tail.cu, and sg2_fused_step rides the SAME 3 real launchers' opt_id switch (dispatch.py). So profile_maximal Tier A DROPS the supergrok2 row (do not invent a path). (2) README '11 launch' — VERIFIED ABSENT (grep -c 0 for both strings), so docs_consistency's README arm fails independently of the glob; the README also carries stale '99 fused cells (33 sm_90 nvcc -c)' claims (~README:239-260) that must be reconciled in fix 4. (3) Extra files present beyond the scope's inventory: decoder_tc_selftest.cu / wgmma_selftest.cu are test-only cpp_extension.load TUs (NOT in setup.py's *.cu glob owned-module path) — they are unaffected and correctly NOT in SM90_REAL_TUS. (4) The _DEAD_SPILL_KERNEL allowlist (profile_maximal.py:198-229) becomes inert once CUTLASS GEMM headers are unlinked — harmless, comment-only staleness, no functional change.

ZERO-QUALITY-LOSS CONFIRMATION: every fix is test/CI-harness or dead-code removal; none touch the shipped _ops binary, the megakernel .cuh sources, the committed .inc, or kernel math. Production parity/collision/quality impact across all 8 fixes: NONE.
